source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Shrub or small tree to ca. 16 m
morphology_documented.bark: Dark brown to blackish, furrowed bark (species key)
morphology_documented.leaves: Alternate, simple, entire (genus), mature blade nearly glabrous; blades usually 6–15 cm long (species key)
morphology_documented.flowers: Usually axillary and imperfectly unisexual, urn- to bell-shaped (genus)
morphology_documented.fruit: Berry to 5 cm in diameter; orange or reddish-orange ripe fruit (species key), fall ripening, may persist to January

source_scope_note: Species vs genus/key-level characters distinguished in text; no undocumented characters inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Contrast D. texana: black 2 cm hairy fruits versus larger orange fruit; bark and leaves differ
preservation: Additive research record, existing species cards, original media, credits and galleries unchanged
